latest_release.name: v4.16.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: correctly close ws connection in web3-eth-contract integration tests by @krzysu in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7338
* fix: export Web3Account, Wallet and signature related types by @krzysu in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7374
* fix: CI workflow cache issues by @krzysu in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7384
* fix: return type of sendTransaction in docs by @krzysu in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7386
* chore: update CI actions by @krzysu in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7385
* Bump express from 4.19.2 to 4.21.1 in /docs by @dependabot in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7388
* Bump ws from 7.4.6 to 8.18.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7171
* Bump micromatch from 4.0.7 to 4.0.8 in /docs by @dependabot in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7225
* [Snyk] Upgrade prism-react-renderer from 2.3.1 to 2.4.0 by @Muhammad-Altabba in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7367
* Bump express from 4.18.1 to 4.20.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7258
* chore: update deps to fix vulnerabilities by @krzysu in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7389
* chore: fix 0 kwei bug by @whitemoshui in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7387
* [Snyk] Upgrade docusaurus-lunr-search from 3.4.0 to 3.5.0 by @Muhammad-Altabba in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7396
* Bump cross-spawn from 7.0.3 to 7.0.6 in /docs by @dependabot in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7399
* [Snyk] Upgrade @mdx-js/react from 3.0.1 to 3.1.0 by @Muhammad-Altabba in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7395
* fix: remove force exit from blackbox tests by @krzysu in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7397
* Replaces #7390, #7391, & #7400 by @danforbes in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7401
* [Snyk] Upgrade @cookbookdev/docsbot from 4.24.0 to 4.24.4 by @avkos in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7403
* chore(deps): bump cross-spawn from 7.0.3 to 7.0.6 by @dependabot in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7404
* update typescript version to 5 by @Muhammad-Altabba in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7272
* chore(deps-dev): bump http-proxy-middleware from 2.0.6 to 2.0.7 by @dependabot in https://github.com/web3/web3.js/pull/7407
